statement:
The speed record for road segment R-9 lists a speed limit of 80 km/h.
The speed record for road segment R-9 listed 80 km/h, but because the active school zone speed limit of 25 km/h is currently in effect (15:10, within the 07:00–16:00 window), the target speed for van V-31 has been safely set to 25 km/h.
judge_text:
WRONG

"listed 80 km/h, but because the active school zone speed limit of 25 km/h is currently in effect" — it contradicts the record's value and supplies the correct 25 km/h.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
